40021211.author: पदार्थः
40021211.content: नर्मदापुलिने on the sandbank of the Narmada, यत्र where, राक्षसेन्द्रः the lord of Rakshasas, सुदारुणः very fierce, पुष्पोपहारम् an offering of flowers, कुरुते performs, तस्मात् from that, देशात् place, अदूरतः not far.

40021211.author: Translation
40021211.content: Not far from the place on the Narmada's sandbank where the very fierce lord of Rakshasas (Ravana) was performing his flower offering, another event was unfolding.

40021212.author: पदार्थः
40021212.content: अर्जुनः Arjuna, जयताम् among the victorious, श्रेष्ठः the best, माहिष्मत्याः of Mahishmati, पतिः the lord, प्रभुः the powerful, क्रीडते plays, सह with, नारीभिः women, नर्मदातोयम् the waters of the Narmada, आश्रितः having resorted to.

40021212.author: Translation
40021212.content: Kartavirya Arjuna, the best among the victorious, the powerful lord of Mahishmati, was sporting with women near the waters of the Narmada.

40021213.author: पदार्थः
40021213.content: तासां of them, मध्यगतो situated in the middle, राजा the king, रराज shone, च and, तदार्जुनः that Arjuna, करेणूनां of female elephants, सहस्रस्य of a thousand, मध्यस्थ situated in the middle, इव like, कुञ्जरः an elephant,

40021213.author: Translation
40021213.content: King Kartavirya Arjuna, situated amidst those women, shone splendidly, just like a male elephant standing in the midst of a thousand female elephants.

40021214.author: पदार्थः
40021214.content: जिज्ञासुः desirous of knowing, सः he, तु indeed, बाहूनां of arms, सहस्रस्य of a thousand, उत्तमं supreme, बलम् strength, रुरोध he obstructed, नर्मदावेगं the current of the Narmada, बाहुभिः with arms, बहुभिः many, वृतः using,

40021214.author: Translation
40021214.content: Desirous of testing the supreme strength of his thousand arms, he indeed obstructed the flow of the Narmada river with his many arms.

40021215.author: पदार्थः
40021215.content: कार्तवीर्यभुजासक्तं held by Kartavirya's arms, तज्जलं that water, प्राप्य having reached, निर्मलम् pure, कूलोपहारं making an offering to the banks (overflowing), कुर्वाणं doing, प्रतिस्रोतः against the current, प्रधावति it rushes,

40021215.author: Translation
40021215.content: That pure water, held back by Kartavirya's arms, then rushed upstream, overflowing and making an offering to the river banks.

40021216.author: पदार्थः
40021216.content: समीननक्रमकरः with fish, crocodiles, and alligators, सपुष्पकुशसंस्तरः with flowers and kusha grass spread out, सः that, नर्मदाम्भसो of the Narmada's water, वेगः current, प्रावृट्काल the rainy season, इव like, अबबभौ it appeared,

40021216.author: Translation
40021216.content: That current of the Narmada's water, filled with fish, crocodiles, and alligators, and strewn with flowers and kusha grass, appeared like the rainy season itself.

40021217.author: पदार्थः
40021217.content: सः that, वेगः current, कार्तवीर्येण by Kartavirya, सम्प्रेषित sent forth, इव as if, अम्भसः of the water, पुष्पोपहारं flower offering, सकलं all, रावणस्य of Ravana, जहार carried away, ह indeed,

40021217.author: Translation
40021217.content: That current, as if propelled by Kartavirya's water, indeed carried away all of Ravana's flower offerings.

40021218.author: पदार्थः
40021218.content: तदा then, रावणः Ravana, तं that, नियमं worship, अर्धसमाप्तम् half-finished, उत्सृज्य casting aside, कान्तां the lovely, नर्मदां Narmada, प्रतिकूलां flowing adversely, प्रियां यथा like a displeased beloved, पश्यते gazes upon.

40021218.author: Translation
40021218.content: Then Ravana, abandoning his half-finished worship, gazed upon the lovely Narmada flowing backward like a beloved turned away in displeasure.

40021219.author: पदार्थः
40021219.content: पश्चिमेन from the west, तु indeed, तम् that, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सागरोद्गारसन्निभम् resembling the gushing forth of the ocean, वर्धन्तम् increasing, अम्भसः of water, वेगम् the current, पूर्वाम् eastern, आशाम् direction, प्रविश्य having entered, तु indeed.

40021219.author: Translation
40021219.content: Having seen that increasing current of water, resembling the gushing forth of the ocean, entering the eastern direction from the west.

40021220.author: पदार्थः
40021220.content: ततः then, अनुभ्रान्तशकुनाम् where birds were flying around, स्वभावोपरमे in the cessation of its natural state, स्थिताम् situated, निर्विकाराङ्गनाभासाम् appearing like an unperturbed woman, अपश्यत् saw, रावणः Ravana, नदीम् the river.

40021220.author: Translation
40021220.content: Then Ravana saw the river, where birds were flying around, situated in a state of cessation of its natural flow, appearing like an unperturbed woman.

40021221.author: पदार्थः
40021221.content: सव्येतरकराङ्गुल्या with the finger of his right hand, सशब्दम् loudly, च and, दशाननः Ravana, वेगप्रभावम् the effect of the current, अन्वेष्टुम् to investigate, सः he, अदिशत् ordered, शुकसारणौ Shuka and Sarana.

40021221.author: Translation
40021221.content: Ravana, with the finger of his right hand, loudly ordered Shuka and Sarana to investigate the effect of the current.

40021222.author: पदार्थः
40021222.content: तौ those two, तु indeed, रावणसन्दिष्टौ ordered by Ravana, भ्रातरौ the two brothers, शुकसारणौ Shuka and Sarana, व्योमान्तरगतौ having gone into the sky, वीरौ the two heroes, प्रस्थितौ set out, पश्चिमामुखौ facing west.

40021222.author: Translation
40021222.content: Those two heroes, the brothers Shuka and Sarana, ordered by Ravana, set out facing west, having ascended into the sky.

40021223.author: पदार्थः
40021223.content: अर्धयोजनमात्रम् only half a Yojana, तु indeed, गत्वा having gone, तौ those two, रजनीचरौ night-wanderers, पश्येताम् they saw, पुरुषम् a man, तोये in the water, क्रीडन्तम् playing, सहयोषितम् with a woman.

40021223.author: Translation
40021223.content: Having gone only half a Yojana, those two night-wanderers saw a man playing in the water with a woman.

40021224.author: पदार्थः
40021224.content: बृहत्सालप्रतीकाशम् resembling a great sala tree, तोयव्याकुलमूर्धजम् with hair dishevelled by water, मदरक्तान्तनयनम् with eyes red at the corners due to intoxication, मदव्याकुलतेजसम् with splendor agitated by intoxication.

40021224.author: Translation
40021224.content: He was like a great sala tree, his hair dishevelled by water, his eyes red at the corners from intoxication, and his might disturbed by the same.

40021225.author: पदार्थः
40021225.content: नदीम् a river, बाहुसहस्रेण with a thousand arms, रुन्धन्तम् obstructing, अरिमर्दनम् the destroyer of enemies, गिरिम् a mountain, पादसहस्रेण with a thousand feet, रुन्धन्तम् obstructing, इव like, मेदिनीम् the earth.

40021225.author: Translation
40021225.content: He was obstructing the river with his thousand arms, like a mountain with a thousand feet obstructing the earth, a true destroyer of enemies.

40021226.author: पदार्थः
40021226.content: बालानाम् young, वरनारीणाम् excellent women, सहस्रेण with a thousand, समावृतम् surrounded, समदानाम् in rut, करेणूनाम् female elephants, सहस्रेण with a thousand, इव like, कुञ्जरम् a male elephant.

40021226.author: Translation
40021226.content: He was surrounded by a thousand young, excellent women, just as a male elephant is surrounded by a thousand female elephants in rut.

40021227.author: पदार्थः
40021227.content: तम् him, अद्भुततमम् most astonishing, दृष्ट्वा having seen, राक्षसौ the two rakshasas, शुकसारणौ Shuka and Sarana, सन्निवृत्तौ having returned, उपागम्य having approached, रावणम् Ravana, तम् him, अथ then, ऊचतुः spoke.

40021227.author: Translation
40021227.content: Having seen that most astonishing being, the two rakshasas, Shuka and Sarana, returned, approached Ravana, and then spoke to him.

40021228.author: पदार्थः
40021228.content: बृहत्सालप्रतीकाशः resembling a great sala tree, कः who, अपि indeed, असौ this, राक्षसेश्वर O lord of rakshasas, नर्मदां the Narmada river, रोधवत् like a dam, रुद्ध्वा having obstructed, क्रीडापयति makes sport, योषितः with women.

40021228.author: Translation
40021228.content: They asked, "O lord of rakshasas, who is this being, resembling a great sala tree, who has obstructed the Narmada river like a dam and is sporting with women?"

40021229.author: पदार्थः
40021229.content: तेन by that, बाहुसहस्रेण by thousand arms, सन्निरुद्धजला having its water obstructed, नदी the river, सागरोद्गारसङ्काशान् resembling the eruptions of the ocean, उद्गारान् eruptions, सृजते emits, मुहुः repeatedly.

40021229.author: Translation
40021229.content: Due to his thousand arms obstructing its waters, the river repeatedly emitted eruptions of water resembling the ocean's surges.

40021230.author: पदार्थः
40021230.content: इति thus, एवम् in this manner, भाषमाणौ speaking, तौ those two, निशाम्य having heard, शुकसारणौ Shuka and Sarana, रावणः Ravana, अर्जुन Arjuna, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, प्रययौ went forth, युद्धलालसः eager for battle.

40021230.author: Translation
40021230.content: Having heard Shuka and Sarana speaking thus, Ravana, eager for battle, declared "Arjuna!" and set forth.

40021231.author: पदार्थः
40021231.content: अर्जुनाभिमुखे facing Arjuna, तस्मिन् in that, रावणे Ravana, राक्षसाधिपे the lord of Rakshasas, चण्डः fierce, प्रवाति blows, पवनः wind, सनादः with sound, सुरजाः divine dust, तथा and so.

40021231.author: Translation
40021231.content: As Ravana, the lord of Rakshasas, faced Arjuna, a fierce, roaring wind blew, and divine dust arose, indicating ill omens.

40021232.author: पदार्थः
40021232.content: सकृदेव just once, कृतः made, रावः a cry, सरक्तः bloody, प्रेषितः sent forth, घनैः by clouds, महोदरमहापार्श्वधूम्राक्षशुकसारणैः by Mahodara, Mahaparshva, Dhumraksha, Shuka, and Sarana.

40021232.author: Translation
40021232.content: A single bloody cry was emitted by the clouds as an omen, while Ravana was accompanied by Mahodara, Mahaparshva, Dhumraksha, Shuka, and Sarana.

40021233.author: पदार्थः
40021233.content: संवृतः surrounded, राक्षसेन्द्रस्तु but the lord of Rakshasas, तत्र there, अगात् went, यत्र where, च and, अर्जुनः Arjuna, अदीर्घेण not long, एव indeed, कालेन by time, सः he, तदा then, राक्षसः Rakshasa, बली powerful, तम् that, नर्मदाह्रदम् Narmada pool, भीमम् terrible, आजगाम came, अञ्जनप्रभः shining like collyrium.

40021233.author: Translation
40021233.content: The lord of Rakshasas, surrounded by his retinue, quickly arrived at the terrible Narmada pool where Arjuna was, that powerful Rakshasa himself shining like collyrium.

40021234.author: पदार्थः
40021234.content: सः He, तत्र there, स्त्रीपरिवृतं surrounded by women, वाशिताभिः by female elephants, इव like, द्विपम् an elephant, नरेन्द्रं the king (of men), पश्यते sees, राजा the king, राक्षसानां of the Rākṣasas, तत् that, अर्जुनम् Arjuna (Kartavirya Arjuna)

40021234.author: Translation
40021234.content: The king of Rākṣasas, Ravana, there saw that King Arjuna, the king of men, surrounded by women, just like an elephant surrounded by female elephants.

40021235.author: पदार्थः
40021235.content: सः He, रोषात् from anger, रक्तनयनः with red eyes, राक्षसेन्द्रः the king of Rākṣasas, बलोद्धतः arrogant with strength

40021235.author: Translation
40021235.content: He, the king of Rākṣasas, arrogant with his power, had his eyes red with anger.

40021236.author: पदार्थः
40021236.content: इति thus, एवम् in this manner, अर्जुन-अमात्यान् to Arjuna's ministers, आह said, गम्भीरया with a deep, गिरा voice, अमात्याः O ministers, क्षिप्रम् quickly, आख्यात inform, हैहयस्य of the Haihaya, नृपस्य of the king, वै indeed

40021236.author: Translation
40021236.content: He thus spoke to Arjuna's ministers in a deep voice, saying, "O ministers, quickly inform the Haihaya king."

40021237.author: पदार्थः
40021237.content: युद्धार्थी desirous of battle, समनुप्राप्तः has arrived, रावणः Ravana, नाम named, राक्षसः a Rākṣasa, रावणस्य Ravana's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, मन्त्रिणः the ministers, अथ then, अर्जुनस्य of Arjuna, ते those, उत्तस्थुः stood up, सायुधास्त्राः with weapons and missiles, च and, रावणम् to Ravana, वाक्यम् words, अब्रुवन् spoke

40021237.author: Translation
40021237.content: Having heard Ravana's words, "A Rākṣasa named Ravana, desirous of battle, has arrived," those ministers of Arjuna then stood up with their weapons and missiles and spoke to Ravana.

40021238.author: पदार्थः
40021238.content: युद्धस्य of battle, कालः the time, विज्ञेयः should be known, साधु well done, भोः O, साधु well done, रावण O Ravana

40021238.author: Translation
40021238.content: The ministers said, "The time for battle should be known; well done, O Ravana, well done!"

40021239.author: पदार्थः
40021239.content: चः and, श्रुत्वा having heard, मन्त्रिणो of the ministers, अथार्जुनस्य then of Arjuna, ते they, यः who, क्षीबं intoxicated, स्त्रीवृतं surrounded by women, चैव and indeed, योद्धुमुत्सहते desires to fight, नृपम् the king, स्त्रीसमक्षं in the presence of women, कथं how, यत्तत् that which, योद्धुमुत्सहसे you desire to fight, अर्जुनम् Arjuna, वाशितामध्यगं being amidst female elephants, मत्तं intoxicated, शार्दूल a tiger, इव like, कुञ्जरम् an elephant.

40021239.author: Translation
40021239.content: Ravana's ministers, having heard Arjuna's ministers, questioned Ravana why he desired to fight an intoxicated king surrounded by women, comparing it to a tiger attacking an intoxicated elephant amidst female elephants.

40021240.author: पदार्थः
40021240.content: क्षमस्वाद्य forgive today, दशग्रीव O ten-necked one, चोष्यतां let it be spent, रजनी the night, त्वया by you, युद्धे in battle, श्रद्धा desire, च and, यद्यस्ति if there is, श्वस्तात tomorrow, O dear one, समरे in battle, अर्जुनम् Arjuna.

40021240.author: Translation
40021240.content: Ravana's ministers advised him to forgive Arjuna for today and spend the night, suggesting that if he still desired battle, he could fight Arjuna tomorrow.

40021241.author: पदार्थः
40021241.content: यद्यद्यास्ति if even today there is, मतिर्योद्धुं a mind to fight, युद्धतृष्णासमावृता enveloped by battle-thirst, निहत्यास्मांस्ततो having killed us then, युद्धमर्जुनेनोपयास्यसि you will engage in battle with Arjuna.

40021241.author: Translation
40021241.content: The ministers further challenged Ravana, stating that if he was still consumed by the thirst for battle today, he would first have to defeat them before he could fight Arjuna.

40021242.author: पदार्थः
40021242.content: ततस्ते then they, रावणामात्यैः by Ravana's ministers, अमात्याः the ministers, पार्थिवस्य of the king, तु indeed, सूदिताश्चापि were killed and also, ते they, युद्धे in battle, भक्षिताश्च and devoured, बुभुक्षितैः by the hungry ones.

40021242.author: Translation
40021242.content: Subsequently, Arjuna's ministers were killed and even devoured in battle by Ravana's hungry ministers.

40021243.author: पदार्थः
40021243.content: ततो then, हलहलाशब्दो a tumultuous sound, नर्मदातीर on the bank of Narmada, आबभौ arose, अर्जुनस्यानुयातऽणां of Arjuna's followers, रावणस्य of Ravana, च and, मन्त्रिणाम् of the ministers.

40021243.author: Translation
40021243.content: Then, a great tumultuous sound arose on the bank of the Narmada, emanating from the followers of Arjuna and the ministers of Ravana.

40021244.author: पदार्थः
40021244.content: इषुभिः with arrows, तोमरैः with lances, शूलैः with spears, त्रिशूलैः with tridents, वज्रकर्षणैः with thunderbolt-like weapons, सरावणान् along with Ravana, अर्दयन्तः tormenting, समन्तात् from all sides, समभिद्रुताः attacked.

40021244.author: Translation
40021244.content: They attacked from all sides, tormenting Ravana and his forces with arrows, lances, spears, tridents, and thunderbolt-like weapons.

40021245.author: पदार्थः
40021245.content: हैहयाधिपयोधानाम् of the warriors of the Haihaya king, वेगः the force, आसीत् was, सुदारुणः very terrible, सनक्रमीनमकरसमुद्रस्य of a sea with crocodiles, fish, and alligators, इव like, निःस्वनः the roar.

40021245.author: Translation
40021245.content: The force of the Haihaya king's warriors was exceedingly terrible, like the roar of an ocean filled with crocodiles, fish, and alligators.

40021246.author: पदार्थः
40021246.content: रावणस्य Ravana's, तु indeed, ते those, अमात्याः ministers, प्रहस्तशुकसारणाः Prahasta, Shuka, Sarana, कार्तवीर्यबलम् Kartavirya's army, क्रुद्धाः enraged, निर्दहन्ति स्म were burning, तेजसा with their might.

40021246.author: Translation
40021246.content: Ravana's ministers, Prahasta, Shuka, and Sarana, enraged, were indeed destroying Kartavirya's army with their fierce might.

40021247.author: पदार्थः
40021247.content: अर्जुनाय to Arjuna, तु indeed, तत्कर्म that deed, रावणस्य of Ravana, समन्त्रिणः with his ministers, क्रीडमानाय who was playing, कथितम् was told, पुरुषैः by men, द्वाररक्षिभिः by gatekeepers.

40021247.author: Translation
40021247.content: That deed of Ravana and his ministers was indeed reported to Arjuna, who was then engaged in sport, by the gatekeepers.

40021248.author: पदार्थः
40021248.content: श्रुत्वा having heard, न not, भेतव्यम् to be feared, इति thus, स्त्रीजनम् to the womenfolk, तम् them, ततः then, अर्जुनः Arjuna, उत्ततार rose up, जलात् from the water, तस्मात् from that, गङ्गातोयात् from the waters of Ganga, इव like, अञ्जनः Anjana (mountain).

40021248.author: Translation
40021248.content: Having heard the news, Arjuna then reassured the womenfolk not to fear, and emerged from the water like the Anjana mountain rising from the waters of the Ganga.

40021249.author: पदार्थः
40021249.content: क्रोधदूषितनेत्रस्तु whose eyes were reddened by anger, सः he, ततः then, अर्जुनपावकः Arjuna who was like fire, प्रजज्वाल blazed forth, महाघोरः exceedingly terrible, युगान्ते at the end of an eon, इव like, पावकः fire.

40021249.author: Translation
40021249.content: Then, Arjuna, whose eyes were red with anger and who was like a blazing fire, shone forth with terrible intensity, like the destructive fire at the end of an eon.

40021250.author: पदार्थः
40021250.content: सः he, तूर्णतरम् very quickly, आदाय taking, वरहेमाङ्गदः adorned with excellent golden armlets, गदाम् mace, अभिदुद्राव rushed towards, रक्षांसि the Rākṣasas, तमांसी darkness, इव like, दिवाकरः the sun.

40021250.author: Translation
40021250.content: Adorned with splendid golden armlets, he swiftly seized his mace and charged at the Rākṣasas, just as the sun dispels darkness.

40021251.author: पदार्थः
40021251.content: बाहुविक्षेपकरणाम् causing the arms to swing, समुद्यम्य lifting up, महागदाम् the great mace, गारुडम् of Garuda, वेगम् speed, आस्थाय assuming, च and, अपपात fell upon, एव indeed, सः he, अर्जुनः Arjuna.

40021251.author: Translation
40021251.content: Lifting his mighty mace, which caused his arms to swing, Arjuna rushed forward with the speed of Garuda.

40021252.author: पदार्थः
40021252.content: तस्य his, मार्गम् path, समारुद्ध्य obstructing, विन्ध्यः Vindhya, अर्कस्य of the sun, इव like, पर्वतः mountain, स्थितः stood, विन्ध्यः Vindhya, इव like, अकम्प्यः unshakable, प्रहस्तः Prahasta, मुसलायुधः armed with a mace.

40021252.author: Translation
40021252.content: Prahasta, armed with a mace, stood in Arjuna's path, obstructing him like the Vindhya mountain blocking the sun, and was as unshakable as the Vindhya itself.

40021253.author: पदार्थः
40021253.content: ततः then, अस्य at him, मुसलम् mace, घोरम् terrible, लोहबद्धम् bound with iron, महोद्धतः very arrogant, प्रहस्तः Prahasta, प्रेषयन् hurling, क्रुद्धः enraged, ररास roared, च and, यथा like, अम्बुदः a cloud.

40021253.author: Translation
40021253.content: Then, the enraged and arrogant Prahasta hurled his terrible, iron-bound mace at Arjuna and roared like a thunderous cloud.

40021254.author: पदार्थः
40021254.content: तस्य its, अग्रे in front, मुसलस्य of the mace, अग्निः fire, अशोकापीडसन्निभः resembling a garland of Ashoka flowers, प्रहस्तकरमुक्तस्य released by Prahasta's hand, बभूव became, प्रदहन् burning, इव as if.

40021254.author: Translation
40021254.content: In front of the mace released by Prahasta's hand, a fire, resembling a garland of Ashoka flowers, appeared as if burning.

40021255.author: पदार्थः
40021255.content: अथ then, आयान्तं coming, तु indeed, मुसलं mace, कार्तवीर्यः Kartavirya, तत् that, अर्जुनः Arjuna, निपुणं skillfully, वञ्चयामास dodged, सगदः with his mace, अगदविक्रमः of unimpaired valor.

40021255.author: Translation
40021255.content: Then, Kartavirya Arjuna, of unimpaired valor and holding his mace, skillfully dodged that incoming mace.

40021256.author: पदार्थः
40021256.content: ततः thereafter, तं him, अभिदुद्राव rushed towards, प्रहस्तं Prahasta, हैहयाधिपः the lord of Haihayas, भ्रामयानः whirling, गदां mace, गुर्वीं heavy, पञ्चबाहुशतोच्छ्रयाम् as high as five hundred arms.

40021256.author: Translation
40021256.content: Thereafter, the lord of Haihayas rushed towards Prahasta, whirling his heavy mace, which was as high as five hundred arms.

40021257.author: पदार्थः
40021257.content: तथा thus, हतः struck, अतिवेगेन with great force, प्रहस्तः Prahasta, गदया by the mace, तदा then, निपपात fell down, स्थितः standing, शैलः mountain, वज्रिवज्रहतः struck by Indra's thunderbolt, यथा as.

40021257.author: Translation
40021257.content: Thus struck by the mace with great force, Prahasta then fell down, like a standing mountain struck by Indra's thunderbolt.

40021258.author: पदार्थः
40021258.content: प्रहस्तं Prahasta, पतितं fallen, दृष्ट्वा having seen, मारीचशुकसारणाः Maricha, Shuka, and Sarana, समहोदरधूम्राक्षाः with Mahodara and Dhumraksha, हि indeed, अपसृष्टाः fled, रणाजिरात् from the battlefield.

40021258.author: Translation
40021258.content: Having seen Prahasta fallen, Maricha, Shuka, Sarana, along with Mahodara and Dhumraksha, indeed fled from the battlefield.

40021259.author: पदार्थः
40021259.content: अपक्रान्तेषु when departed, अमात्येषु the ministers, प्रहस्ते Prahasta, वै indeed, निपातिते having been struck down, रावणः Ravana, अभ्यद्रवत् rushed towards, तूर्णम् quickly, अर्जुनम् Arjuna, नृपसत्तमम् the best among kings,

40021259.author: Translation
40021259.content: After his ministers had retreated and Prahasta was killed, Ravana quickly rushed towards Kartavirya Arjuna, the best among kings.

40021260.author: पदार्थः
40021260.content: सहस्रबाहोः of the one with a thousand arms, तत् that, युद्धम् battle, विंशद्बाहोः of the one with twenty arms, च and, दारुणम् terrible, नृपराक्षसयोः of the king and the demon, तत्र there, च and, आरब्धम् began, रोमहर्षणम् hair-raising,

40021260.author: Translation
40021260.content: There, a terrible and hair-raising battle began between the king with a thousand arms (Arjuna) and the demon with twenty arms (Ravana).

40021261.author: पदार्थः
40021261.content: सागराविव like two oceans, संरब्धौ enraged, चलन्मूलौ with moving roots, इव like, अचलौ two mountains, तेजोयुक्तौ endowed with splendor, इव like, आदित्यौ two suns, प्रदहन्तौ burning, इव like, अनलौ two fires,

40021261.author: Translation
40021261.content: They were enraged like two oceans, like two mountains with their roots shaking, like two suns full of splendor, and like two burning fires.

40021262.author: पदार्थः
40021262.content: बलोद्धतौ arrogant with strength, यथा like, नागौ two elephants, वाशितार्थे for the sake of a female, यथा like, वृषौ two bulls, मेघाविव like two clouds, विनर्दन्तौ roaring, सिंहाविव like two lions, बलोत्कटौ exceedingly strong,

40021262.author: Translation
40021262.content: They were like two elephants arrogant with strength, like two bulls fighting over a cow, like two roaring clouds, and like two exceedingly strong lions.

40021263.author: पदार्थः
40021263.content: रुद्रकालौ Rudra and Kala, इव like, क्रुद्धौ enraged, तदा then, तौ those two, राक्षसार्जुनौ the demon and Arjuna, परस्परम् each other, गदाभ्याम् with maces, तौ those two, ताडयामासतुः struck, भृशम् fiercely,

40021263.author: Translation
40021263.content: Then, those two, the demon Ravana and Arjuna, enraged like Rudra and Kala, fiercely struck each other with their maces.

40021264.author: पदार्थः
40021264.content: वज्रप्रहारान् thunderbolt strikes, अचलाः mountains, यथा just as, घोरान् terrible, विषेहिरे endured, गदाप्रहारान् mace strikes, तौ those two, तत्र there, सेहाते endured, नरराक्षसौ the man and the demon.

40021264.author: Translation
40021264.content: Just as mountains endure terrible thunderbolt strikes, so too did the man (Arjuna) and the demon (Ravana) endure each other's mace strikes in that battle.

40021265.author: पदार्थः
40021265.content: यथा just as, अशनिरवेभ्यः from the sounds of thunder, तु indeed, जायते arises, अथ then, प्रतिश्रुतिः echo, तथा similarly, तयोः of those two, गदापोथैः by the impacts of maces, दिशः directions, सर्वाः all, प्रतिश्रुताः echoed.

40021265.author: Translation
40021265.content: Just as an echo arises from the sounds of thunder, similarly, all directions reverberated with the impacts of their maces.

40021266.author: पदार्थः
40021266.content: अर्जुनस्य of Arjuna, गदा mace, सा that, तु indeed, पात्यमाना being struck, अहितोरसि on the chest of the enemy, काञ्चनाभम् golden-hued, नभः sky, चक्रे made, विद्युत् lightning, सौदामिनी a flash of lightning, यथा just as.

40021266.author: Translation
40021266.content: Arjuna's mace, when struck upon the enemy's (Ravana's) chest, made the sky appear golden-hued, just like a flash of lightning.

40021267.author: पदार्थः
40021267.content: तथैव similarly, रावणेन by Ravana, अपि also, पात्यमाना being struck, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, अर्जुनोरसि on Arjuna's chest, निर्भाति shone, गदोल्का a mace-meteor, इव like, महागिरौ on a great mountain.

40021267.author: Translation
40021267.content: Similarly, Ravana's mace, struck repeatedly on Arjuna's chest, shone like a meteor striking a great mountain.

40021268.author: पदार्थः
40021268.content: न not, अर्जुनः Arjuna, खेदम् weariness, आयाति attained, न nor, राक्षसगणेश्वरः the lord of the demon hosts, इदम् this, आसीत् was, तयोः of those two, युद्धम् battle, यथा like, पूर्वम् formerly, बलीन्द्रयोः of Bali and Indra.

40021268.author: Translation
40021268.content: Neither Arjuna nor the lord of the demon hosts (Ravana) showed any weariness, and their battle was like the ancient conflict between Bali and Indra.

40021269.author: पदार्थः
40021269.content: शृङ्गैरिव like with horns, वृषायुध्यन् two bulls fighting, दन्ताग्रैरिव like with the tips of tusks, कुञ्जरौ two elephants, परस्परं each other, तौ those two, निघ्नन्तौ striking, नरराक्षससत्तमौ the best of humans and demons.

40021269.author: Translation
40021269.content: The two, the best among humans and demons, struck each other like two bulls fighting with their horns or two elephants with the tips of their tusks.

40021270.author: पदार्थः
40021270.content: ततो then, अर्जुनेन by Arjuna, क्रुद्धेन enraged, सर्वप्राणेन with all his might, सा that, गदा mace, स्तनयोरन्तरे between the breasts, मुक्ता thrown, रावणस्य of Ravana, महोरसि on the great chest.

40021270.author: Translation
40021270.content: Then, the enraged Arjuna, with all his might, hurled that mace at Ravana's broad chest, between his breasts.

40021271.author: पदार्थः
40021271.content: वरदानकृतत्राणे protected by boons, सा that, गदा mace, रावणोरसि on Ravana's chest, दुर्बलेव as if weak, यथावेगं with its full force, द्विधाभूत्वा splitting into two, अपतत्क्षितौ fell on the ground.

40021271.author: Translation
40021271.content: That mace, striking Ravana's chest which was protected by boons, split into two and fell to the ground as if it were weak, despite its full force.

40021272.author: पदार्थः
40021272.content: स he, तु but, अर्जुनप्रमुक्तेन by Arjuna released, गदापातेन by the impact of the mace, रावणः Ravana, अपासर्पत् recoiled, धनुर्मात्रं a bow's length, निषसाद sat down, च and, निष्टनन् groaning.

40021272.author: Translation
40021272.content: But Ravana, struck by the mace released by Arjuna, recoiled a bow's length, sat down, and groaned.

40021273.author: पदार्थः
40021273.content: स he, विह्वलं bewildered, तत् that, आलक्ष्य having seen, दशग्रीवं Dashagriva, ततो then, अर्जुनः Arjuna, सहसा suddenly, उत्पत्य leaping up, जग्राह seized, गरुत्मानिव like Garuda, पन्नगम् a serpent.

40021273.author: Translation
40021273.content: Perceiving Dashagriva to be bewildered, Arjuna then suddenly leaped up and seized him, just as Garuda seizes a serpent.

40021274.author: पदार्थः
40021274.content: सः He, तु indeed, बाहुसहस्रेण with a thousand arms, बलात् by force, गृह्य having seized, दशाननम् Daśānana (Rāvaṇa), बबन्ध bound, बलवान् powerful, राजा king, बलिम् Bali, नारायणः Nārāyaṇa, यथा just as.

40021274.author: Translation
40021274.content: The powerful King Kārtavīrya Arjuna, using his thousand arms, forcibly seized Daśānana (Rāvaṇa) and bound him, just as Nārāyaṇa (Viṣṇu) had bound Bali.

40021275.author: पदार्थः
40021275.content: बध्यमाने while being bound, दशग्रीवे Daśagrīva, सिद्धचारणदेवताः Siddhas, Chāraṇas, and deities, साध्वीतिवादिनः saying "excellent!", पुष्पैः with flowers, किरन्ति scattered, अर्जुनमूर्धनि on Arjuna's head.

40021275.author: Translation
40021275.content: As Daśagrīva was being bound, the Siddhas, Chāraṇas, and deities, exclaiming "excellent!", scattered flowers upon Arjuna's head.

40021276.author: पदार्थः
40021276.content: व्याघ्रः a tiger, मृगम् a deer, इव like, आदाय having seized, मृगराट् a lion, इव like, दन्तिनम् an elephant, ननाद roared, हैहयः Haihaya, राजा king, हर्षात् from joy, अम्बुदवत् like a cloud, मुहुः repeatedly.

40021276.author: Translation
40021276.content: The Haihaya king (Kārtavīrya Arjuna) roared repeatedly with joy, like a tiger seizing a deer or a lion capturing an elephant, and like a thundering cloud.

40021277.author: पदार्थः
40021277.content: प्रहस्तः Prahasta, तु but, समाश्वस्तः having recovered, दृष्ट्वा having seen, बद्धम् bound, दशाननम् Daśānana, सह with, तैः those, राक्षसैः Rākṣasas, क्रुद्धः enraged, च and, अभिदुद्राव rushed towards, पार्थिवम् the king.

40021277.author: Translation
40021277.content: But Prahasta, having recovered from his shock upon seeing Daśānana bound, became enraged and, along with those Rākṣasas, rushed towards the king.

40021278.author: पदार्थः
40021278.content: नक्तञ्चराणाम् of the night-wanderers, वेगः the rush, तु indeed, तेषाम् of them, आपतताम् who were rushing, बभौ appeared, उद्भूतः arisen, आतपापाये at the end of the hot season, पयोदानाम् of clouds, इव like, अम्बुधौ in the ocean.

40021278.author: Translation
40021278.content: The rush of those charging Rākṣasas appeared like the gathering of monsoon clouds over the ocean at the end of the hot season.

40021279.author: पदार्थः
40021279.content: मुञ्च मुञ्चेति "release, release" thus, भाषन्तः speaking, तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति "stop, stop" thus, च and, असकृत् repeatedly, मुसलानि maces, सशूलानि with spears, सः he (Ravana's army), उत्ससर्ज hurled, तदा then, अर्जुने at Arjuna.

40021279.author: Translation
40021279.content: Then, Ravana's army repeatedly hurled maces and spears at Arjuna, shouting "release, release" and "stop, stop."

40021280.author: पदार्थः
40021280.content: अप्राप्तानि not yet reached, एव just, तानि those (weapons), आशु quickly, असम्भ्रान्तः undisturbed, तदा then, अर्जुनः Arjuna, आयुधानि weapons, अमरारीणाम् of the enemies of gods, जग्राह caught, अरिनिषूदनः the destroyer of enemies.

40021280.author: Translation
40021280.content: Then, the undisturbed Arjuna, the destroyer of enemies, quickly caught those weapons of the Rakshasas even before they reached him.

40021281.author: पदार्थः
40021281.content: ततः then, तैः by those, एव just, रक्षांसि the Rakshasas, दुर्धरैः formidable, प्रवरायुधैः with excellent weapons, भित्त्वा having pierced, विद्रावयामास made to flee, वायुः wind, अम्बुधरान् clouds, इव like.

40021281.author: Translation
40021281.content: Then, with those very formidable and excellent weapons, Arjuna pierced and dispersed the Rakshasas, just as the wind scatters clouds.

40021282.author: पदार्थः
40021282.content: राक्षसान् the Rakshasas, त्रासयित्वा having frightened, तु and, कार्तवीर्यः Kartavirya, अर्जुनः Arjuna, तदा then, रावणम् Ravana, गृह्य having seized, नगरम् the city, प्रविवेश entered, सुहृद्वृतः surrounded by friends.

40021282.author: Translation
40021282.content: Then, after frightening the Rakshasas, Kartavirya Arjuna seized Ravana and entered the city, surrounded by his friends.

40021283.author: पदार्थः
40021283.content: सः he (Arjuna), कीर्यमाणः being showered, कुसुमाक्षतोत्करैः with heaps of flowers and unbroken rice grains, द्विजैः by Brahmins, सपौरैः along with citizens, पुरुहूतसन्निभः resembling Puruhuta (Indra), तदा then, अर्जुनः Arjuna, सम्प्रविवेश entered, ताम् that, पुरीम् city, बलिम् Bali, निगृह्य having captured, इव like, सहस्रलोचनः the thousand-eyed one (Indra).

40021283.author: Translation
40021283.content: Then, Arjuna, resembling Indra, entered that city, being showered with heaps of flowers and unbroken rice grains by Brahmins and citizens, just as the thousand-eyed Indra entered after capturing Bali. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे द्वात्रिंशः सर्गः ।। 32 ।। Thus ends the thirty-second sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
